CLI: `--gar-loss-mode smooth_saturation --gar-target 0.3` (train_phase2.py:107, 110)

L_GAR = -target × tanh(GAR / target)，default target=0.3:

| GAR | L_GAR | 梯度 dL/dGAR | 梯度强度(% of max) |
|-----|-------|-------------|-------------------|

| 0.9 | -0.299 | -0.010 | 1% |
